usedFor: Help Scout holds support conversations and customers, and HubSpot keeps the contact record updated through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Customer” in Help Scout, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A changed customer in the help desk should not leave a stale contact, and the action matches by email.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in HubSpot updates an existing contact by email, so the customer must already exist there.
